Method of Attack: Compromised PyPI account to publish a malicious update
Stripped original package content and replaced with malicious code
Downloaded and executed a malicious executable from a hardcoded IP address
Installed NovaSentinel stealer malware with clipboard hijacker and persistence mechanisms
Impacted Systems: Systems with the django-log-tracker package installed
Systems with browser secrets, crypto wallets, Discord tokens, wifi passwords, WinSCP, Minecraft, Roblox, etc.
Attack Vector: Supply-chain attack via a compromised PyPI account
Hardcoded IP address to download malicious executable
